inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.help: What runs on what: hosts, their containers and guests, and the services on them. Found from addresses about once an hour; what nexdeck only guesses from a name waits for your yes. When something goes down, what runs on it is told in one message, and its cards say why.
inventory.unplacedHelp: These run on nothing nexdeck knows of. Pick where they run, or leave them.
inventory.empty: Nothing found yet. Add a Docker, Portainer, Synology or Proxmox connection, then look again.
inventory.runsOnHelp: What this needs to work. When that is down, this one is not told on its own; its card says why.
inventory.mapHelp: One column per machine, its containers and guests below, and what runs in each beside it. A name leads to its diagnosis; red is down, dashed only proposed.
inventory.suggestionContainer: {{child}} probably runs in the container {{name}} on {{host}}
inventory.showAll: Show all containers ({{count}} with nothing in them)
inventory.nothingKnown: {{count}} containers or guests, nothing known to run in them
